preferences.description: Adjust the interface language and visual theme.
preferences.themeDescription: Preview and apply a theme card.

help.title: Help and shortcuts
help.description: Switching projects changes the project context while keeping you on the same page.

welcome.title: Welcome to ForceTrack
welcome.description: Here is a quick tour of the workspace so you can start planning and tracking work with confidence.

project.title: Keep work separated by project
project.description: Switch projects here or open project management. Tasks, sprints, and members stay scoped to the selected project.
project.emptyDescription: Once you create projects, use this switcher to move between them or open project management.

emptyWorkspace.title: Create your first project
emptyWorkspace.description: Start here to create a focused workspace for its tasks, sprints, and members.

navigation.title: Move through the delivery flow
navigation.description: Use Summary, Backlog, Board, and Timeline to move from planning to day-to-day delivery and review.

workspace.title: Work in the current view
workspace.description: Each page starts with its purpose and primary actions. The content below always reflects the current project.

summary.title: Summary: understand project health
summary.description: Start here for a high-level view of progress, recent activity, priorities, work types, and team workload.

summaryWorkspace.title: Focus the Summary
summaryWorkspace.description: Use the filters below this heading to narrow every metric and chart by date, assignee, work type, status, epic, or priority.

backlog.title: Backlog: shape upcoming work
backlog.description: Move here to capture, search, filter, and order work before it enters an active Sprint.

backlogWorkspace.title: Plan Sprints deliberately
backlogWorkspace.description: Create planned Sprints, drag work between sections, set Sprint goals, and start the next delivery cycle from this view.

board.title: Board: deliver the active Sprint
board.description: The Board keeps the current Sprint visible and groups its work by delivery status.

boardWorkspace.title: Keep status current
boardWorkspace.description: Drag cards across To Do, In Progress, In Review, and Done so the team always shares the same delivery picture.

timeline.title: Timeline: review the schedule
timeline.description: Use the Timeline to see dated work across a shared calendar and spot scheduling pressure early.

timelineWorkspace.title: Coordinate dates visually
timelineWorkspace.description: Adjust the visible range, review overdue or out-of-range work, and open unscheduled tasks that still need dates.

help.title: Come back whenever you need
help.description: Open Help and shortcuts to review keyboard shortcuts or replay this tour at any time.

empty.title: Create your first project
empty.description: Start a project to organize tasks, sprints, and members in one place.

create.title: Create project
create.description: Create an independent space for tasks, sprints, and members.

manage.title: Project management
manage.description: Create, review, edit, or delete local projects.
manage.editDescription: Update the project name and description.
manage.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes {{name}} with {{tasks}} tasks, {{sprints}} sprints, and {{members}} members. This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteFailed: The project could not be deleted. Try again.

validation.name_too_long: Keep the project name to 80 characters or fewer.
validation.description_too_long: Keep the description to 500 characters or fewer.
validation.unknown: The project could not be created. Try again.

board.title: Board
board.description: Track the active sprint and move work through delivery.
board.noSprintDescription: Plan work in the Backlog and start a sprint to make it available on the Board.

dnd.instructions: To pick up a task, press Space. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move it. Press Space again to drop, or Escape to cancel.

dialog.createDescription: Add the details needed to move this work forward.

placeholders.description: Add context, acceptance criteria, or reproduction steps…

list.title: Tasks
list.description: Temporary list view for creating and maintaining task details.
list.empty: No tasks yet. Create the first one to get started.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.description: Your edits have not been saved. You can keep editing or discard them.

delete.title: Delete this task?
delete.description: {{title}} will be permanently removed from Board and Timeline.

feedback.recovered: Stored task data was invalid, so ForceTrack restored the demo tasks.
feedback.saveFailed: Changes are visible for now, but could not be saved to this browser.

validation.titleTooLong: Keep the title to 100 characters or fewer.

validation.dateRange: Due date cannot be earlier than start date.

summary.description: See project health across status, priority, and team workload.
summary.noEpicProgress: No epics match this view yet.

filters.title: Filter summary

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.description: Rank future work and decide what enters the active sprint.

backlog.backlogHint: Work not yet committed to a sprint
backlog.plannedSprintHint: A planned sprint that has not started
backlog.emptySprint: No work is planned for the active sprint.
backlog.noFilterResults: No work items match the current search and filters.

dnd.instructions: To pick up a work item, press Space. Use the arrow keys to choose a sprint or the backlog, then press Space to drop, or Escape to cancel.

sprint.createDescription: Create a planning container, then schedule work from the backlog.
sprint.editDescription: Update the sprint name, goal, or schedule.

sprint.completeDescription: Complete {{name}}? Choose where to move {{count}} incomplete work items.

member.title: Project members
member.description: Manage people who can be assigned work in this project. Members are stored locally; no invitation email is sent.
member.emptyDescription: Add a member to make them available for task assignment.
member.removeLastOwner: A project must keep at least one owner.
member.removeReferenced: Reassign tasks owned or reported by this member first.
member.removeDescription: {{name}} will no longer be available for new task assignments in this project.
member.last_owner: The last project owner cannot be removed.
member.member_has_tasks: Reassign this member's tasks before removing them.
member.removeFailed: The member could not be removed.
member.createDescription: New members can immediately be selected as assignee or reporter.

validation.email_duplicate: This email already belongs to a project member.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Review work by start date, due date, and delivery window.
timeline.emptyDescription: Add a start date or due date to a work item to place it here.
timeline.noScheduled: No dated work items. Use the unscheduled list below.
